verdict.rationale: Framer's own docs describe a built-in AI agent that works inside the project. Users can hand it tasks such as creating pages, sections, copy and visuals, restyling a whole site, making layouts responsive, wiring interactions, and setting up the CMS, with conversational refinement and manual takeover on the canvas. This is a native assistant, separate from the external-agent connection. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-product agent, and documentation of its limits on scope and autonomy for multi-step tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Framer’s AI agent creates editable pages, sections, copy, and visuals directly in your project. Keep refining in the conversation, or take over on the canvas at any point.
The agent takes care of colors, fonts, component styles, motion and effects across your site.
The CMS agent sets up, organizes, and updates your entire CMS, connecting it directly to the canvas so content and design stay in sync.
It adapts your layouts across breakpoints, adjusting stacks, type sizes, spacing, and image crops until everything works.
The agent handles the wiring so you can focus on the design, not the how-to.
